revision_history.title: Kiara enduro durability, quality capped
revision_history.dose: 90-120 minutes with two to three controlled climb-descent loops.

revision_history.title: Kiara one-stage Pure Quill precision touch
revision_history.dose: One Pure Quill run and required egress, 60-70 minutes.
revision_history.coaching_correction: Saturday was over-weighted as a freshness constraint; Tuesday's execution drift remains the primary density constraint.

decision_basis.wellness: Wake Body Battery 92, current 77, HRV balanced at 48 ms, resting HR 48, stress 15, but sleep only 5.43 hours with score 70.
decision_basis.garmin_diagnosis: Maintaining, ACWR 1.1 optimal, load focus balanced; permits controlled repeatability but does not justify a hard durability day.
decision_basis.tuesday_response: Tuesday produced load 277.2, RPE 8, 44.6 minutes in Z4-Z5, and a strained next-day response score of 50; 35 percent modeled MTB neural carryover remains in the 48-hour window.
decision_basis.density: Monday plus Tuesday load is 293.4 against the 280-370 weekly planning range; a second run must be earned and total load remains capped.
decision_basis.saturday_context: The church 3.5 km walk-run plus simple telematch is athlete-classified low-load social/recovery activity, so it is a secondary constraint rather than the reason for today's cap.
decision_basis.weather_gate: Morning riding window only; current forecasts indicate afternoon thunderstorm risk. Abort for audible thunder, lightning, rapidly darkening sky, or unsafe trail conditions.

session.title: Kiara conditional two-run Pure Quill repeatability
session.purpose: Build controlled Pure Quill repeatability by making the second run contingent on clean climbing, technical precision, rapid recovery, and stable trail conditions rather than motivation.

dose.loop_one: One conversational climb to Twin Peak at RPE 2-3, followed by the familiar Pure Quill line at 60-65 percent. Treat this as the admission audit, not a warm-up for more work.
dose.second_loop_gate: Start climb two only if every gate passes: climb one stayed conversational at RPE 3 or lower without a breath-catching stop; run one had wide vision, deliberate brake release, no reactive correction, no consequential root deflection, and no near miss; braking and upper-body fatigue are each 2/10 or lower; after a 3-5 minute reset breathing and legs normalize and mental clarity, vision width, and line-choice speed remain normal; trail grip remains predictable with no active rain, thunder, or rapidly worsening sky.
dose.loop_two_if_admitted: Climb two at RPE 4 or lower with no attack, threshold, or sprinting; repeat the same Pure Quill line at 65-70 percent, seeking matched posture and precision rather than more speed.
dose.yellow_or_failed_gate: Use the required approximately one-third DH-line egress at transport pace immediately after run one; no second climb or substitute stage.
dose.red_or_cns_block: Do not start technical MTB; return home and recover.
dose.hard_cap: Two Pure Quill runs maximum plus required egress; 85-105 minutes elapsed with 105 minutes as the hard cap.
dose.load_cap: Expected Garmin load 80-110 with 120 as the absolute post-session ceiling; session RPE no higher than 5.

session.adaptation_hypothesis: A clean first cycle followed by one earned same-route repetition should train enduro-specific repeatability and dynamically centred front-tyre authority without recreating Tuesday's high-aerobic execution drift.
execution_rules: Ride Pure Quill only; TnT, Flintstone, and the full DH Line are excluded, with the partial DH Line used only for required egress.
Keep tyre pressures, fork and shock air, rebound, LSC, HSC, cockpit, and cleat setup unchanged; no HSC test.
Use the familiar/reference line on both runs; do not retry Tuesday's novel aggressive straight line over the damp off-camber roots.
Technical cue: create pressure on grippy soil before roots, remain dynamically centred with free elbows, release unnecessary braking and steering across the roots, then rebuild pressure after.
Use right-front-foot bias only as a momentary corrective cue, not as a permanent twisted stance.
The second run must reproduce control; faster time, greater aggression, or motivation cannot substitute for passing the gate.
Fuel from minute 15-20 using the stored 90-150-minute KL heat range; carry delay fuel without using it as permission for a third run.
Clear the technical trail before the forecast afternoon thunderstorm window; live thunder or lightning overrides every other gate.

expected_result.technical: If two runs are completed, run two matches run one for early line choice, dynamically centred posture, deliberate braking, stable front tracking, and decision speed, without emergency correction.
expected_result.physiology: Climb one remains RPE 3 or lower, climb two remains RPE 4 or lower, total load stays inside 80-110, and the session does not become another VO2 or threshold exposure.
expected_result.next_day: Friday legs, upper body, and decision speed remain functional without unusual fatigue.

stop_rules: Do not start with brain fog, narrowed vision, delayed processing, weak or heavy feel at easy effort, illness symptoms, active thunder/lightning, or unsafe trail conditions.
Do not start loop two if any admission gate fails; motivation and Garmin green cannot override a failed technical, physiological, recovery, or weather gate.
Downshift and take the safest direct exit if climbing becomes sustained RPE 5, conversational control is lost, HR/RPE drifts disproportionately, or a breath-catching stop is needed.

Stop technical intent for reactive braking, delayed line choice, rearward freezing, front-wheel deflection requiring emergency recovery, a near miss, confidence outrunning precision, narrowed vision, or braking/upper-body fatigue above 3/10.
The second Pure Quill descent ends the session; no third climb, other full stage, setup test, new line, jumps, or sprints.
